source.modified: Converted from Magics' named contour styles and modified by GeoRiva: shaded styles only, translated to levels and one colour per band as Magics draws them, units and groups taken from Magics' rule files, renamed.

units.name: Degree Celsius
units.description: Celsius temperature scale. Common display unit for surface temperature.

units.name: Celsius difference
units.description: A difference of temperatures in degrees Celsius, such as an anomaly or a range.

units.name: Centimetre
units.description: A hundredth of a metre. Used for snowmelt and snow evaporation.

units.name: Metre
units.description: SI unit of length. Used for geopotential height, wave height, visibility.

units.name: Geopotential decametre
units.description: Ten geopotential metres. The unit geopotential height is charted in.

units.name: Hectopascal
units.description: Standard unit for atmospheric pressure in meteorology.

units.name: Kilogram per square metre per hour
units.description: Precipitation rate as a water mass flux. 1 kg/m²/h of water is 1 mm/h.

units.name: Metre per second
units.description: SI unit of speed. Native unit for wind components in NWP output.

units.name: Pascal per second
units.description: Pressure tendency. Used for vertical velocity (omega).

units.name: Second
units.description: SI unit of time. Used for wave and swell periods.

units.name: Percent
units.description: Used for relative humidity, cloud cover, soil moisture fraction.

units.name: Gram per kilogram
units.description: Mass mixing ratio. Used for specific humidity.

units.name: Joule per kilogram
units.description: Specific energy unit. Used for CAPE, CIN, geopotential.

units.name: Microgram per cubic metre
units.description: Mass concentration. Used for particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10).

units.name: Dimensionless
units.description: Unitless quantity. Used for indices (NDVI, SPI, anomaly scores etc).
